description_en: Retrieves the real-time logs of a service test
description_zh: 获取服务测试实时日志
kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier list-service-test-task-logs --task-id stt-568c2c5a687a409b977e --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAWns8w4MmhzeptXVRG0PUEU= --sort-order Ascending --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceTestTaskLogs

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的行数。每页最大100行，默认为20行
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

Ascending: sorts the results in ascending order.

Descending (default): sorts the results in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值范围：

Ascending：升序
Descending（默认值）：降序
parameters.name: sort_order
